mapper.select: select member_idx, member_id, member_name, member_phone, member_gender, member_email, member_join_date, member_level, member_status from tb_member order by member_idx desc
mapper.update: update tb_member set member_id=#{memberId}, member_name=#{memberName}, member_phone=#{memberPhone}, member_gender=#{memberGender}, member_email=#{memberEmail}, member_status=#{memberStatus} where member_idx=#{memberIdx}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_member(member_id, member_pwd, member_name, member_phone, member_gender, member_email) values (#{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberGender}, #{memberEmail})
mapper.select: select room_idx, room_name, room_size, room_basic_person, room_max_person, room_price_weekdays, room_price_weekend, room_price_shoulder_weekdays, room_price_shoulder_weekend, room_price_peak_weekdays, room_price_peak_weekend, room_service from tb_room
mapper.update: update tb_room set room_name=#{roomName}, room_size=#{roomSize}, room_basic_person=#{roomBasicPerson}, room_max_person=#{roomMaxPerson}, room_price_weekdays=#{roomPriceWeekdays}, room_price_weekend=#{roomPriceWeekend}, room_price_shoulder_weekdays=#{roomPriceShoulderWeekdays}, room_price_shoulder_weekend=#{roomPriceShoulderWeekend}, room_price_peak_weekdays=#{roomPricePeakWeekdays}, room_price_peak_weekend=#{roomPricePeakWeekend}, room_service=#{roomService} where room_idx=#{roomIdx}
mapper.delete: delete from tb_resource where resource_idx in (#{resourceIds})
